info.title: Qentry field scanner — current scoped OpenAPI snapshot
info.description: Generated from FastAPI. Does not enumerate middleware/domain outcomes; see FIELD_SCANNER_TECHNICAL_AR.md. Proposed SSE is not implemented. Field device headers are operationally required despite optional schemas.

post.description:
Login with email and password via Supabase Auth.
If user belongs to multiple tenants, returns tenant list for selection.

Refresh the access token.

The refresh token comes from the HttpOnly cookie for browsers, or from the
JSON body for native clients.  Cookie-based refresh changes server state, so it
requires a custom header that a cross-site form cannot send.
Logout — sign out from Supabase (invalidates refresh token).

get.description:
Get current user info + profile + list of tenants with roles.
When X-Tenant-ID header is set, includes permissions for that tenant.
This is the main endpoint the frontend calls after login.

post.description: Invite a user to the current tenant.

get.description: List all invites for the current tenant.

schema.title: Response List Invites Api V1 Invites Get

post.description: Accept an invite using the token. User must be authenticated.

Snapshot a current operational group into a shift.

The current group is first attached to the event operation; its current
members then become immutable shift assignments.  Later group edits do not
alter this shift.

get.description:
Return the signed-in operator's field-safe account and device context.

This is deliberately a self-service profile endpoint, not a user directory.
It returns no invitation data, no auth token, and only the small set of
permissions that affect field operation.

List only events for which the caller has an operational gate assignment.

This endpoint intentionally returns event identity and schedule only.  It
lets a field member plan ahead without disclosing invitation statistics or
guest information before the event's local operating day.

Return a field-safe event briefing only on the event's local date.

The gate member receives aggregate invitation numbers and their own gates,
never a list of invitees.  The same local-date rule is enforced here and
in device-session creation so a manipulated mobile UI cannot open a future
event early.
Return only the caller's shifts for a local operating day.

post.description: Start the one allowed field-device session for the current shift.
Perform one online, session-bound atomic check-in from raw scan text.

get.description: Minimal, scoped manual lookup — never a browsable guest list.

post.description: Close the caller's own device session as a documented handover.

get.description:
Create a minimal offline pack for the caller's current gate session.

The response purposefully exposes only salted token fingerprints and entry
constraints.  Names, email, phone, unmasked QR content, and the database
invitation id never cross this endpoint.

post.description:
Idempotently reconcile a device's encrypted offline queue.

A stale/revoked pack can only create review audit entries: it cannot add a
check-in.  Valid packs use the same atomic server routine as online scans;
first valid arrival wins any inter-device offline conflict.

get.description: Live attendance metrics for the responsible operational team.
View history. This is supervisory access, not field-scan access.

InviteMembershipRole.description:
Roles that may be granted through the self-service invite flow.

Ownership transfer is intentionally excluded: it requires an explicit
owner-controlled handover rather than an email token.
